import limited_client as robot, numpy as np
o=robot.observe(camera=0); r=o['robot']; K=o['intrinsic']; T=o['camera_to_world']
pc=np.linalg.inv(T)@np.r_[r['tcp_position'],1.]
uv=K@pc[:3]; uv=uv[:2]/uv[2]
print('status',robot.status(),'tcp',r['tcp_position'],'pixel',np.round(uv,1),'cam_depth',round(float(pc[2]),3))
print('joints',r['joint_positions'],'gripper',r['gripper_positions'])
for u,v in [(int(uv[0]),int(uv[1])),(180,350),(200,350),(220,350),(200,365),(230,365)]:
 u=max(0,min(479,u)); v=max(0,min(479,v)); d=float(o['depth_m'][v,u])
 p=T@np.array([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],d,1.])
 print((u,v),'d',round(d,3),'world',np.round(p[:3],3))
PY
